# M13 independent synthetic reference cohort

The protocol and wire expectations were committed before M13 product execution.
Six development cases exercise six declared strata; six held-out cases are
predeclared and remain unexecuted. Reference labels are human-readable synthetic
expectations, not measured model outputs. Wire responses are separately specified
fixtures. The real source evaluator is reused; its original fixtures remain
unchanged. Do not tune labels, exclusions or denominators after outputs.

The diagnostic workflow has two merchant profiles and no live provider calls.
Actual hosted quality, cost, latency, tokenizer/context safety and formal product
qualification need their separately authorized observations. Zero shadow business
effects is an invariant, not a measured financial benefit.
